text:
sasha: Heads up — Console defaulting to 0% for new variants is causing confusion. Created an experiment and variant A got 0; seeding didn't kick in. Anyone seen this?

priya: I saw that. I think we only run seeding when baseline has >0 traffic. That's intentional to avoid accidental pop.

mike: That behavior was introduced in the rollout-api change last month. We added an `explicit_seed` flag to force seeding even at 0.

sasha: Where's the flag? Console doesn't expose it. Users hit 'create' and then wonder why no traffic.

jordan: @mike can we expose `explicit_seed` in the create flow? Maybe default it to true for experiments created via quickstart.

mike: We could, but risk for enterprise customers that want strict control. Maybe add a checkbox: "Seed variants when total traffic is 0 (advanced)" :gear:

priya: Also found a weird router validation error when rules reference `session.country` and it's not in the attribute schema — console happily saved it but router drops traffic at runtime.

sasha: That's bad. Should be a guard at create-time. We should validate rule attributes against the route's available attribute model.

mike: Agreed. We already validate metric names but not attribute keys. I'll open a PR to the console schema validator.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout-api v2.11 available — validation fixes

jordan: Telemetry note — `experiment_created` event missing `experiment.slug` when created via api2, only id present. Evals pipeline expects slug for human reports.

sasha: Can we add `experiment.slug` to telemetry and also include `variant.seeded` boolean? That will help SRE investigate early ramps.

priya: Yes. Also suggest adding event `seed_attempt` with reason and outcome (success/failure + error) to telemetry.

mike: Plan: PR to console exposing explicit_seed checkbox + UX copy, PR to rollout-api to validate attribute keys, telemetry PR to add slug + seed_attempt. Targeting next sprint. Anyone want ownership?

sasha: I'll pick console checkbox + UX copy. Draft copy: "Automatically seed new variants when no live traffic exists (advanced)".

jordan: I'll take telemetry.

priya: I'll spec validator tests — edgecases for nested attributes and unknown keys.

mike: Thanks. Filing linked issues and pinging @eng-platform when ready. Also adding a short migration note for Dedicated customers about explicit seeding.
